title: Towards Efficient Simultaneous Inverse Text Normalization with Pretrained Text-to-Text Language Model and Read-Tag-Write Policy
abstract: arXiv:2610.19492v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Streaming Inverse Text Normalization (ITN) is vital for converting spoken-form outputs from streaming Automatic Speech Recognition into formatted written text. Existing streaming ITN methods rely on hybrid systems combining neural tagging with expert-crafted finite-state transducer rules, limiting scalability across domains and languages. While end-to-end models offer superior scalability by learning directly from data, standard encoder-decoder architectures are inherently non-streaming due to global attention. In this paper, we propose an efficient streaming end-to-end ITN system, adapting a pretrained text-to-text model to leverage its robust linguistic knowledge. To enable streaming, we introduce architectural adaptations, a specialized training strategy, a Read-Tag-Write decoding policy, and inference optimizations. translated_title: 基于预训练文本到文本语言模型与“读-标注-写”策略的高效同步逆向文本规范化研究
translated_abstract: 流式逆向文本规范化（ITN）对于将流式自动语音识别输出的口语形式转换为格式化的书面文本至关重要。现有的流式ITN方法依赖于将神经标注与专家手工构建的有限状态转换器规则相结合的混合系统，这限制了跨领域和跨语言的可扩展性。虽然端到端模型通过直接从数据学习提供了卓越的可扩展性，但标准的编码器-解码器架构由于全局注意力机制而本质上无法进行流式处理。在本文中，我们提出了一种高效的流式端到端ITN系统，通过适配预训练的文本到文本模型来充分利用其强大的语言知识。为实现流式处理，我们引入了架构适配、专门的训练策略、“读-标注-写”解码策略以及推理优化。在越南语数据集上的实验表明，该系统的准确性与非流式基线相当，且优于混合方法……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于预训练文本到文本语言模型的高效流式端到端逆向文本规范化系统，通过架构适配、专门训练策略和“读-标注-写”解码策略实现流式推理，其准确性媲美非流式基线并超越混合方法。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an efficient streaming end-to-end Inverse Text Normalization system built on a pretrained text-to-text language model, which enables streaming inference through architectural adaptations, a specialized training strategy, and a Read-Tag-Write decoding policy, achieving accuracy comparable to non-streaming baselines and outperforming hybrid methods.
